description: This file defines a React component called NoteCard, which displays a note with timestamp, message, tags, and provides copy functionality. It also includes a skeleton component for loading states.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp to a relative time string like '5m ago' or 'Jan 2, 2023' depending on how recent the timestamp is.

methods.name: formatFullTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a fully formatted timestamp string with date and time for display.

methods.name: NoteCard
methods.description: React component that renders a note card with timestamp, message (HTML parsed), tags, and copy button with hover effects.

methods.name: NoteCardSkeleton
methods.description: React component that renders a skeleton placeholder for loading state of NoteCard.
